function copy<T>(value: T & { a: number }): T & { a: number } {
  return { ...value };
}
function inferCopy<T>(value: T & { a: number }) {
  return { ...value };
}
function make<D, M>(value: { data: D; methods: M & ThisType<D & M> }): D & M {
  return { ...value.data, ...value.methods };
}
function replace<T>(value: T & { a: string }) {
  return { ...value, a: 12 };
}
function copyBare<T>(value: T): T {
  return { ...value };
}
function union<T, U>(value: (T & { side: 'left' }) | (U & { side: 'right' })) {
  return { ...value, copied: true };
}
class Box<T> {
  constructor(public value: T) {}
  read() { return this.value; }
}
function spreadBox<T>(box: Box<T>) {
  return { ...box };
}
const direct: { a: number; b: string } = copy({ a: 1, b: 'direct' });
const inferred: { a: number; b: string } = inferCopy({ a: 2, b: 'inferred' });
const counter = make({ data: { count: 5 }, methods: { add(delta: number) { this.count += delta; } } });
counter.add(2);
const replaced: { a: number } = replace({ a: 'old' });
const bare: { b: string } = copyBare({ b: 'bare' });
const either = union<{ label: string }, { count: number }>({ side: 'left', label: 'alternate' });
const label = either.side === 'left' ? either.label : either.count;
const box = spreadBox(new Box('box'));
console.log(direct.b, inferred.b, counter.count, replaced.a, bare.b, label, box.value, 'read' in box);
